summary.one_liner: Strategr is a no-fuss time-management desktop app that helps users time-box their day using "strategies," written in C++17 with a Qt 5 UI.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Strategr as a tool for time-boxing the day with strategies to maximize productivity. The data model is written in vanilla C++17 and the UI layer uses Qt 5. The README lists macOS and Windows as supported platforms, with iOS, Linux and Android unchecked. Building is described as currently supported only on macOS, with dependencies managed through vcpkg and configured via CMake presets. The README says the project is being reworked and that it may build on Windows and Linux with a fix or two. It mentions a website for more information but gives no feature details beyond this.
use_cases: plan and time-box my daily schedule
structure my workday with productivity strategies
desktop time management on macOS or Windows
build a Qt C++ desktop productivity app
how_to_run: ./scripts/setup_vcpkg.sh (run once to set up vcpkg dependencies)
notable: Data model in vanilla C++17 separated from a Qt 5 UI layer
Dependencies managed with vcpkg and CMake presets
Listed as a no-fuss time management app among macOS productivity apps
caveats: Building is currently only officially supported on macOS; Windows and Linux may need fixes
The README says the project is being reworked, so it may be unstable
iOS, Linux and Android are not supported according to the platform checklist
